metadata.title: Trump's threatened tax on overseas data centers clouds US Big Tech's India buildout

content.text:
US President Donald Trump's threat to impose a "tremendous tax" on American companies that build data centers abroad has put a question mark over the tens of billions of dollars Google, Microsoft, and Amazon have pledged for cloud and AI infrastructure in...
